name: Tikhonov Regularization
summary: Stabilize ill-posed inverse problems by penalizing parameter size or deviation from prior structure.
core_idea: Add a regularization penalty to the data-misfit objective to select more stable solutions.
innovation: Encodes stabilizing prior structure through an explicit penalty and its strength.

start_here.why: Canonical monograph on stable regularization of inverse problems.
start_here.focus: Regularization penalties, stability and convergence arguments.

curation_note: Original methodological formulation reviewed; starting reference is advisory, not a quota.
